comparability_requirements: same issuer, currency, unit, entity, and statement basis
design.currency_basis: same verified financial currency; no inferred FX conversion
design.daily_delta_use: only newly effective post-baseline validated change; preserve M3 cutoff lineage
directional_core_usage: cash-conversion evidence, not an automatic thesis verdict
negative OCF is a fact requiring sector and stage context
design.entity_attribution_basis: same issuer, consolidation scope, statement basis, and attribution basis
forbidden_derivations: EBITDA, operating income, or net income as OCF proxy
cumulative YTD labeled as a single quarter
industrial interpretation for a financial institution
design.initial_analysis_use: eligible as absolute evidence when valid and material
message_usage: label operating cash flow and period explicitly
avoid implying a working-capital cause without supporting facts
design.missing_data_behavior: Unknown for a cash-conversion claim; otherwise no negative inference
design.monitoring_baseline_use: may enrich baseline; enrichment is not Daily Delta

safe_derivations.formula: current YTD OCF - prior-quarter YTD OCF
safe_derivations.name: ocf_qtd

safe_derivations.formula: prior FY + current YTD - prior comparable YTD
safe_derivations.name: ocf_ttm

design.single_quarter_vs_cumulative_semantics: QTD, YTD, FY, TTM, and point-in-time remain distinct; no label-based guess
design.valuation_usage: context for denominator quality only; no multiple, price target, or valuation fact
design.warning_kill_condition_use: may support warning when material and contextual; no one-period automatic kill
